question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that object in every place?
premises: The meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
This range covers the full span of reality.
inference: One should meditate on that object in every place as pervading all levels from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on him in place after place as extending from Śiva down to Avīci...
